description: This Java class defines a Fragment for an Android app that demonstrates how to clip a View using an Outline, including toggling clip settings and changing displayed text on click.

classes.name: ClippingBasicFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that demonstrates clipping a View with an Outline, with interactive button and text views.

classes.name: ClippingBasicFragment.ClipOutlineProvider
classes.description: A custom ViewOutlineProvider that creates a rounded rectangle inset by 10% for clipping.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets up the outline provider and sample texts.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up view references, click listeners, and initializes the UI components.

methods.name: changeText
methods.description: Updates the TextView with a new string from the sample texts array based on click count.
